task: Make the llmc proxy route /metrics to llama-server. Context: llama-server is always started with --metrics and exposes Prometheus metrics on its internal port 8080. `make metrics` curls http://localhost:11434/metrics, but the proxy currently 404s it as an unknown route. Add the route so GET /metrics on the proxy forwards to the llama backend (llama_server:8080, same path). Constraints: it must behave like the other proxied GET routes - read-only, so it must NOT trigger a GPU mode swap; when llm mode is not active it must 503 cleanly with the service_inactive message instead of swapping. Add a unit test in llmc/tests/test_proxy.py covering the route (proxies to llama when active; does not trigger a swap when idle - mirror the existing test_get_train_route_does_not_trigger_swap pattern). Do not refactor anything else.
rules: Only touch files under llmc/ - everything else is out of scope.
GET routes must never trigger a GPU mode swap; reuse the existing _classify/_ensure_and_forward machinery rather than inventing a parallel path.
A check satisfied by a stub or a route that returns canned text is a FAILED iteration - /metrics must actually proxy the backend's response.
The proxy must keep booting and the full unit suite must stay green; the live sensor rebuilds and restarts the real proxy container with your code.

sensors.name: unit-tests
sensors.hint: the llmc unit + schema suite must stay green; read the failure and fix your change, not the test

sensors.name: route-registered
sensors.hint: proxy.py has no /metrics route; add it to the routing (_classify or an explicit handler)

sensors.name: live-metrics
sensors.cmd: make build-proxy restart >/dev/null 2>&1 && sleep 2 && curl -sf -m 10 http://localhost:11434/metrics | rg -q 'llama'
sensors.hint: the running proxy must serve llama-server's Prometheus metrics through :11434/metrics; if the proxy fails to boot your code is broken - check make logs-proxy

sensors.name: judge
sensors.cmd: judge --base HEAD --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3 --spec 'The proxy must route GET /metrics to the llama backend (llama_server:8080) so `make metrics` works: (1) the route forwards the backend response, not canned text; (2) it is read-only - a GET must never trigger a GPU mode swap, and must 503 cleanly when llm mode is not active, consistent with the existing route discipline; (3) a unit test in llmc/tests/test_proxy.py covers the new route; (4) changes are confined to llmc/ and reuse the existing _classify/_ensure_and_forward machinery rather than a parallel code path; (5) ignore .pi/** entirely - it is operator scaffolding for the loop, not part of the change. Reject stubs, parallel routing hacks, and justifying essays in comments.'
sensors.hint: the frontier judge rejected the diff; read its findings and address the specific defect it names
